{{Alo inversion}}The Omega Covenant is the first of the three [[Covenants]]. It is a covenant dedicated to the [[Omega]]. 

It is the covenant of Love, and its [[Three Fruits|fruit]] is [[immortality]] and [[Mirroring|inclusion]].

It is run by the [[Omega Priesthood]]

== Text ==
ω Do not commit murder or otherwise deprive people from immortality

λ Do not institutionally deprive people of immortality

α Do not spread hatred

== Interpretation ==
The Omega Covenant is meant to be easy to follow. Theoretically a serial rapist could follow the Omega Covenant in simple form and be entitled to immortality.

The three commandments are organized in the [[Ola]] order.

Commandment Omega refers simply to 

For those moving from the Omega Covenant to the Lambda Covenant the [[Extended Omega Covenant]] is the first thing to do<ref>https://evolution.faith/extended-omega-covenant/</ref>
